metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1999 · The Color of Paradise
metas.description: The story of Mohammed, a blind Iranian boy and his father, Hashem, who is always oscillating between accepting his son as he is and abandoning him, as he represents a burden for him, after the loss of his wife.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1998 · Kirikou and the Sorceress
metas.description: Kirikou, an unusual little boy, must search the wisdom of the forbidden mountain in order to save his village from a spell cast by the evil sorceress Karaba

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1995 · The White Balloon
metas.description: Several people try to help a little girl to find the money her mom gave her to buy a goldfish with.

metas.name: ★ 9.0 · 1991 · Sandesham
metas.description: After his retirement, Raghavan Nair (Thilakan) is back at his home. His long cherished dream to spend his retired life along with his family is thwarted after seeing his two sons brawling each other over their political differences.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1991 · Attention, Papa Arrives!
metas.description: After ordering enough typewriting paper for 40 years, just to get discount, Heinrich Lohse is forced to retire. The former manager has plenty of time now to spend with his wife and their 16 year old son. But - do they want that?

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1998 · Goodnight Mr Tom
metas.description: A shy and quiet World War II evacuee is housed by a disgruntled old man, and they soon develop a close bond.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1994 · Redhat and Cousin
metas.description: Kolah Ghermezi is a naughty school boy. His playfulness gets him expelled from school and he fails to find a job. He sees a program on TV which attracts his attention and he goes to Tehran. With the help of Pesarkhaleh, he goes to the TV program he had seen and finds the reporter. He likes the reporter so much that he decides to help him overcome the obstacles he faces for getting married, but instead causes troubles.
